answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond in a common vault before trading. Honest agents get the bond back after verified work; cheaters lose it. That turns identity creation from free into costly, so a sybil attacker must fund each fake separately and loses money on every one caught. Peer auditors watch for duplicate behavior the way a falcon watches a field, and a zephyr of low-cost random spot checks keeps cheating more expensive than honest work.
